notes.title: 2024-01 Update Content
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, there have been some new updates this month, as follows:

[olist]
 Add directional signs to prevent you from getting lost in the town.
 Added a mini game ranking function. This ranking cannot view the scores of other players, but it can record your current score and view your current level of mini games.
The "Dark Chase" gameplay will also provide opportunities for repeated gameplay in towns in the future. After the first experience, you can see your own playing time.
A new signboard has been added by the river. After each chapter of the plot, why not come here to check out the updated gossip.
 Added a review function for reviewing the past 100 conversations by pressing the Ctrl key during conversations, allowing you to view them even if you accidentally miss them.
 Multiple new bedrooms have been added, and now houses in urban areas can be accessed.
 Add actions for urban characters to make the town more vibrant~
[/olist]

notes.title: Annual Summary&DEMO Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

2023 is coming to an end, thank you all for your support and encouragement over the past six months. The overall progress of game production is currently around three-quarters, and we strive to complete the remaining content production within the next few months.
Since the release of DEMO, many players have provided us with valuable suggestions, and during this period, we have been able to grow and accumulate valuable experience.
Although we are only a very small team, our experience and technological strength are relatively insufficient. But as long as we can improve the gaming experience and satisfy everyone, we will do our best.
If you have any questions or suggestions in the future, as long as they are feasible, we will coordinate them into the research and development schedule.


We have recently updated DEMO to version 0.6, which includes:
-New "Dark Chase" level (opened after the end of Chapter 1)
-Add three new plot segments (at the beginning of Chapter 1, the end of Chapter 2, and the end of Chapter 4)
-Optimize game interface operations
-Fix the issue of inconsistent storage time
-Fix the issue with saving screenshots
-Art updates on the gameplay of the imperial examination
-Some NPCs have updated their image


This is the major update we will make before the official version is completed, and we will also update the optimization and patch content in a timely manner in the future.
After the launch of DEMO, there were indeed mixed reviews at the beginning, and we carefully examined the shortcomings of the game. With several updates, it gradually turned into positive reviews. Currently, nearly 10000 players have played our game, and the attention on social platforms is also increasing.
As a niche game category, we do not aim to become a phenomenon level game overnight, but rather to provide the best experience for every player who has played our game.
Finally, we are still considering other languages, please stay tuned.

notes.title: Trial version update&follow-up planning
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the trial version has been online for a few days now. Thank you for playing and providing feedback.

We have received a lot of useful suggestions these days, and we have made immediate modifications and updates. As of now, we have fixed the following content:



 Add opening storyline

 Cancel the stamina bar limit and modify stamina related tasks

 The gameplay for the imperial examination can be skipped

 Fix screen freeze bug

 Other experience minor optimizations



Of course, there are still some content that needs to be optimized that has not been produced yet. We will update it gradually in the next month.

Many players have given feedback that the plot in the first four chapters is dull, and we have also noticed this aspect. This game is a slow paced game, and there were indeed some shortcomings in providing suspense at the beginning, which were not considered in the early stages of production.

We have decided to add some new storyline content for the early stages of the game, and friends who have already played DEMO can experience it again in the official version.
If you have any other good suggestions, please feel free to contact us through various channels~

Finally, our exposure on Steam greatly depends on the number of wish lists. Even if you have participated in crowdfunding or decided to pre order, please kindly place a wish list. Thank you sincerely~

notes.title: We will release a trial version by the end of the year
notes.notes:
We will provide a trial version of this work by the end of this year (no later than December 31st), including the first four chapters and a process of about 90 minutes.

In addition to the plot, the trial version also includes several small games, a complete program framework, and a rich exploration map.

The content of the trial version does not represent the final quality. We hope everyone can provide more feedback after experiencing it~! You can contact us through comments, social media, email, and other channels!

The official version will still be available no later than April next year! Please support me a lot!
